summary: Handles normalization of AI model identifiers across various naming conventions and user-friendly aliases.
responsibilities: Defines the canonical list of supported AI model identifiers.
Maps colloquial or shorthand aliases to standardized, canonical model names.
Provides a normalization function to sanitize and map input strings to known model names.
Implements key generation logic for case-insensitive and prefix-agnostic model matching.
